notes.title: French, Chinese, and German Translations NOW AVAILABLE! [0.5.61]
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/2dedd59d97f23330d98a8c9a8f3e7b200efc7577.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/af1bedadfa7c5dea7761c87d0a1155f992db2af5.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Translations[/b][/h2][p align="start"]It's finally ready![/p][p align="start"]Please note that the  French, Chinese, and German languages are translated with AI. And there may be a few inconsistencies.[/p][p align="start"]I've given the French version to a native proofreader, and he confirmed it was accurate, so I went ahead and translated Chinese and German.[/p][p align="start"]For the Russian translations, someone reached out to me and volunteered to translate the files manually, so it will take a bit longer than the others.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Moving forward, I'll most likely be releasing translations ONLY at the end of a Chapter, given the complexity of my process. For those who don't know, I create the visual novel engine that the game runs on myself, and this creates several levels of complexity in my development process.[/p][p align="start"]So, for example, new content in v0.5.7 - v0.6.6 will be English only, then v0.6.7 will be fully translated.[/p][p align="start"]Right now, this is the most feasible option for me, but I'll see if that changes in the future.[/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Bugs[/b][/h2][p align="start"]If you experience any game-breaking bugs in v0.5.61, please report it on my Discord, then switch back to v0.5.6 using the steps below, via the properties option on Steam.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/7ce2d486c542fbb121ba61a080fc6e4b00bdb724.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][/p][h2][b]Conclusion[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Hope you guys enjoy the translations, it's been requested for a very long time now, and took an extremely long time to make lol.[/p][p align="start"]That's all for now, take care and love y'all! 💖[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]V0.5.61 Changelog:[/p][p align="start"]- Coded localization feature
- Added translations for French, Chinese, and German[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update (August 13, 2025) - Chapter 3 Progress & Looking For French Testers
notes.content: [h3][b]I Need French Testers[/b][/h3][p]Before I start with the dev update, I just wanna announce that I built a French-translated version of the game. It took 3 weeks of work to code the localization feature, then I used ChatGPT to help make the translations. I need someone to help me confirm the accuracy and let me know if it's okay to release it officially. If it goes well, then I can translate the game to other languages as well.[/p][p][/p][p]Hit me up on Discord if you're interested.[/p][p][url="https://discord.com/invite/hsySvfbC3f"]https://discord.com/invite/hsySvfbC3f[/url][/p][p]Thanks![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Hello![/b][/h3][p]Hey guys! I hope you're all doing great! 😄[/p][p align="start"]Man, these past couple of weeks have been a crazy emotional rollercoaster, what with all the censorship news going around, especially with adult games. It's been really tough trying to stay focused, but I managed to get some work done.[/p][p align="start"]There's so much stuff I did, I'm not even sure what to include in the devlog 💀[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Quest Planning[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Done! I was able to create all the chapter 3 quests, and even played through all of them in the game. Without the dialogues, of course. The dialogue files are empty placeholders for now.[/p][p align="start"]Here's the roadmap for Chapter 3. Each of these cards represents a quest objective/dialogue (blurred out for obvious reasons). I may end up moving some stuff around as I continue to work on the chapter, so you can think of it as a first draft.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/56d974e32e3c395388f89da2418b60e07d3e0f4c.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/7356ad8e4900aa2743bb239b66d2dc7f906f8506.png"][/img][/p][p]There are 68 cards/dialogues in total, more or less the same as Chapter 2. Some will be shorter than others.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/073364a9a37ea2aabe0ab6f9924e97490447d826.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Implementing these in the code was a nightmare. Last time I only had 4 characters to work with... Now it's 8 💀 . I've already played and tested the quests multiple times to make sure there are no bugs, and so far I think I've caught most of them, but I'll probably have to do several more in the future. Sandbox games are a pain to make lol, but I love it.[/p][p align="start"]My progress tracker in the future will be based on these cards. So the completion percentage will depend on how many dialogues I've written. (The image is a sample btw, I've not actually written 30)[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/0ca797884d1d8ec6cc58e46b576d474f8c96e39a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Some Improvements To The Inventory System[/b][/h3][p align="start"]While testing, I quickly came to realize that the inventory space, especially in the key inventory, was getting too small. It was never designed to have more than one page cuz I never thought I'd make so much shit that it wouldn't fit in there lol. But ya, after a lot of coding, you can hoard as much stuff as you want now, and view them in multiple pages.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/aec3cd646a8f11029f5cf851fccdba8acd499e6e.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]What's Next?[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Now that I've finished planning the quests, there's a lot of stuff I need to do before I can start writing the dialogues.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Character Daily Routines[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/e7b558e6a9f68b31f07e260053f3898a04baa79d.png"][/img][/p][p]I've already plotted out their daily routines, in other words, where they'll be on the map at different times of the day; all that's left is to create the renders. So far, I'm done with the new girl, and it shouldn't take too long to finish the others. The frustrating part is that I like to make multiple versions of each render so I can pick the best-looking one.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Game Design Stuff[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44996313/55c3113bdeb180e8464fe32f668eacbe56ae1fc0.png"][/img][/p][p]I still need to implement ways of increasing character relationships and player stats, and create things for the player to do with the stats. Stuff that makes it feel like a game. It'll be way less grindier than Chapter 2, if you thought it was lol.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Conclusion[/b][/h3][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Phew, that's as much as I could fit into this devlog, there are soooo many micro tasks I had to omit, especially in the code. I apologize if this devlog seemed messier than usual, there's just some much stuff on my mind lol. But progress is going very well, and we're one step closer to the end (of CC)![/p][p align="start"]Till next time, take care, stay safe, love y'all! 💖[/p]

notes.title: "I Dream Of Evelyn" Achievement Fix Patch [0.5.43]
notes.content:
v0.5.43 Changes
- Fixed an issue where the "I Dream Of Evelyn" achievement could not be unlocked even after completing the sequence.

Hey guys! This one is a very minor patch.
I was looking at the achievements completion page a few minutes ago and noticed no one had completed the Evelyn achievement, so I went into the project files to review my code and noticed I forgot to include it 🤦‍♂️
I added and tested it in one of my previous system designs but accidentally omitted it on the final one.

But ya, it's fixed now
If you recently played the scene in the last patch (0.5.42), the achievement should unlock the moment you load your save game.

That's all for now.
Thanks, and love y'all! 💜

MetalB

notes.title: Achievements Patch [0.5.42]
notes.content:
v0.5.42 Changes
- I've created 23 new Achievements that can now be unlocked in the game.
- Balanced the Charlie nighttime sequence
- A whole lotta technical changes that I lost track of, but you don't have to worry about those

For existing save files, some achievements will be unlocked immediately after loading your save game.
However, most of them will have to be replayed due to the new variables I created to keep track of the achievement's progress. Once an old save is loaded, these new variables will be initialized to zero, and then properly updated the next time you save/load a game.

For the Achievements integration, what I did was more complicated than just making the achievements trigger once a certain dialogue line is read. I created a complex system that allows me to set complex requirements to unlock achievements.
To get this to work exactly the way I wanted, I had to overhaul existing core systems in the game and even modified several existing dialogues.

I've thoroughly tested all my changes, but if anyone encounters any issues, please let me know.

Thanks, and love y'all! 💜

MetalB
